---
title: "Coverage"
resources:
  - coverage/
---

```{julia}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
# `generate_coverage(...; run_test=true)` runs the whole test suite under coverage
# instrumentation, which dominates the book render. Both PR-facing jobs set
# MFO_DOCS_SKIP_COVERAGE=true to skip it — the preview in preview.yml and the render
# smoke test in CI.yml. The published builds in Docs.yml never set it, so the
# deployed report is always the real one.
#
# This cell must stay `output: false`. The `Pkg.test` subprocess inherits the
# notebook's captured stdout, so its whole log is this cell's output — under
# `output: asis` it is spliced into the page as raw markdown and pandoc never
# finishes. The page text lives in the separate `asis` cell below.
skip_coverage = get(ENV, "MFO_DOCS_SKIP_COVERAGE", "") == "true"
if !skip_coverage
    using LocalCoverage
    coverage = generate_coverage("MatrixFreeOperators"; run_test=true)
    html_coverage(coverage; dir=joinpath(@__DIR__, "coverage"), open=false)
    cov_dir = joinpath(dirname(dirname(@__DIR__)), "coverage")
    mv(joinpath(cov_dir, "lcov.info"), joinpath(@__DIR__, "lcov.info"); force=true)
    rm(cov_dir; recursive=true, force=true)
end
```

```{julia}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
if skip_coverage
    println("""
This page is empty in pull-request previews. Building the report runs the full
test suite under coverage instrumentation, which would add roughly half an hour
to every preview.

The report for the development docs is published
[here](https://rallypointone.github.io/MatrixFreeOperators.jl/dev/pages/coverage.html).
""")
else
    println("""
<iframe id="coverage-iframe" src="coverage/index.html" width="100%" style="border:none; overflow:hidden;" scrolling="no"></iframe>

<script>
(function() {
    var iframe = document.getElementById('coverage-iframe');
    function resize() {
        try {
            iframe.style.height = iframe.contentDocument.documentElement.scrollHeight + 'px';
        } catch(e) {}
    }
    iframe.addEventListener('load', resize);
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
})();
</script>
""")
end
```
